items.t: Automatic transmission slips, goes into limp mode or fails
items.job: Replace automatic transmission with remanufactured unit
items.note: Owners report $3,500-5,500 for a replacement. A used unit costs less.

items.t: Automatic transmission shifts out of gear and lurches
items.job: Repair or replace transmission valve body
items.note: Owners report about $2,300 on average.

items.t: Window falls into the door or stops working
items.job: Replace window regulator
items.note: Owners report about $700 at a shop for a power window repair.

items.t: Window actuator fails early
items.job: Replace window regulator and motor

items.t: Ignition coils fail and cause misfires (recall)
items.job: Replace ignition coils and spark plugs
items.note: The original coil recall was free; on a car this old, expect to pay for replacement coils.

items.t: Wiring near the battery tray can chafe (recall)
items.job: Reroute and repair engine wiring harness
items.note: Free at a VW dealer under the recall.

items.t: Brake lights may not work correctly (recall)
items.job: Replace brake light switch with redesigned part
items.note: Free at a VW dealer under the recall.

items.t: Airbags can deploy too forcefully in minor crashes (recall)
items.job: Replace front airbag crash sensor
items.note: Free at a VW dealer under the recall.

items.t: Diesel can leak from the high-pressure pump (recall)
items.job: Replace high-pressure pump fastener
items.note: Free at a VW dealer under the recall.

items.t: Headliner sags or falls down
items.job: Recover headliner

items.t: Dashboard turns sticky or melts
items.job: Strip coating or install dash cover

items.t: Fuel line can chafe and leak (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace chafed fuel line
items.note: Free at a VW dealer under the recall.

items.t: Windshield cracks without an impact
items.job: Replace windshield
items.note: Owners report about $500.

items.t: Engine stalls or shuts off while driving
items.job: Diagnose stalling (codes, fuel pressure, sensors)

items.t: Engine failure at high mileage
items.job: Replace engine with used or remanufactured unit
items.note: Owners report $7,000-19,500 for engine repairs or replacement.

items.t: Driver airbag inflator can rupture (recall)
items.job: Replace driver frontal airbag module
items.note: Free at a VW dealer under the recall.

items.t: Key can come out when not in Park (recall)
items.job: Install added shifter switch and circuit board
items.note: Free at a VW dealer under the recall.

items.t: Rear trailing arm can crack after a crash (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace rear trailing arm
items.note: Free at a VW dealer under the recall.

items.t: Wet passenger seat can switch the airbag on for a child seat (recall)
items.job: Update or replace passenger seat sensor
items.note: Free at a VW dealer under the recall.

items.t: Glass sunroof can shatter (recall)
items.job: Replace sunroof glass panel
items.note: Free at a VW dealer under the recall.

items.t: Transmission cooler seals can leak (recall)
items.job: Replace transmission oil cooler seals
items.note: Free at a VW dealer under the recall.

items.t: Fuel rail cap can leak fuel (recall)
items.job: Replace fuel rail
items.note: Free at a VW dealer under the recall.

items.t: Brake vacuum pump drive can fail (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace camshaft / vacuum pump drive
items.note: Free at a VW dealer under the recall.

items.t: Brake caliper pistons may reduce braking (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace brake calipers
items.note: Free at a VW dealer under the recall.

items.t: Instrument cluster may not warn of brake failure (recall)
items.job: Update instrument cluster software
items.note: Free at a VW dealer under the recall.

items.t: Water pump and thermostat housing leak coolant
items.job: Replace water pump and thermostat housing assembly

items.t: Engine burns oil
items.job: Oil consumption test and PCV valve replacement
items.note: If new pistons and rings are needed, the bill runs to several thousand dollars.

items.t: Headlight bulbs burn out early or headlights stop working
items.job: Replace headlight bulbs and repair bulb harness

items.t: Coolant temperature sensor fails
items.job: Replace coolant temperature sensor and seal

items.t: Coolant reservoir cracks and leaks
items.job: Replace coolant reservoir and cap

items.t: Mass airflow sensor fails
items.job: Replace mass airflow sensor
